title: Receiver Thermal Noise
text: Apply receiver thermal noise to complex signal, 1 input, 1 output, {Specification method} sets Thermal noise specification method Noise; {Noise temperature (K)}, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the receiver noise figure, {Noise factor} sets the receiver noise factor, {Add 290K antenna noise} sets the option to add 290 K antenna noise, {Reference load (ohm)}, {Random number source} sets the source for random number stream Global, {Initial seed} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In1
ports.summary: Baseband signal scalar | column vector | matrix

ports.name: Out1
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | column vector | matrix

params.name: Specification method
params.values: Thermal noise specification method Noise temperature (default) | Noise figure | Noise factor

params.name: Add 290K antenna noise
params.values: Option to add 290 K antenna noise off (default) | on

params.name: Random number source
params.values: Source for random number stream Global stream (default) | mt19937ar with seed

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
